title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures inch up after Trump delivers State of the Union, Nvidia earnings loom
title_zh: 今日股市：特朗普发表国情咨文、英伟达财报临近后，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货小幅上涨
summary: Futures on the major gauges dip ahead of a highly anticipated State of Union address by the president.
summary_zh: 在总统发表备受期待的国情咨文演讲之前，主要股指期货下跌。

title: AI trade: Who are the hardware winners and the services losers?
title_zh: 人工智能贸易：谁是硬件赢家，谁是服务输家？
summary: Stifel vice president of portfolio strategy Thomas Caroll joins the Market Domination team to address Big Tech's rising capex spending on AI and define which companies are the biggest winners in AI hardware and which are the losers in AI services.
summary_zh: Stifel 投资组合策略副总裁 Thomas Caroll 加入市场主导团队，以解决大型科技公司在人工智能方面资本支出不断上升的问题，并确定哪些公司是人工智能硬件领域的最大赢家，哪些公司是人工智能服务领域的输家。

title: 'Boring' energy, consumer staples stocks can buffer tech losses
title_zh: “乏味”的能源和消费必需品股票可以缓冲科技股的损失
summary: STORY: Meanwhile, tech stocks have been "a mixed bag," Mussio said, with most falling - including Microsoft, Nvidia, Meta Platforms and Amazon.He added that "it is worth noting" that companies such as Nvidia and Microsoft have market caps bigger than some entire sectors, "like...
summary_zh: 故事：与此同时，穆西奥表示，科技股“鱼龙混杂”，其中大多数下跌，包括微软、英伟达、Meta Platforms 和亚马逊。他补充说，“值得注意的是”英伟达和微软等公司的市值比一些整个行业还要大，“比如……

title: Earnings live: Workday stock plunges amid AI disruption concerns, Lucid falls on mixed quarter, HP tumbles
title_zh: 财报实时显示：由于对人工智能颠覆的担忧，Workday 股价暴跌，Lucid 季度业绩好坏参半，惠普股价暴跌
summary: The S&P 500 was on track for double-digit earnings growth, with more than half of companies having reported Q4 results so far.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数有望实现两位数的盈利增长，迄今为止已有超过一半的公司公布了第四季度业绩。

title: Meta strikes massive 6-gigawatt AI chip deal with AMD
title_zh: Meta 与 AMD 达成 6 吉瓦 AI 芯片大规模交易
summary: Meta Platforms (META) landed a multi-year, 6-gigawatt GPU deal with chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices (AMD).
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 与芯片制造商 Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 达成了一项为期多年的 6 吉瓦 GPU 协议。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq jump as software leads AI relief rally ahead of Nvidia earnings
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数上涨，因软件在 Nvidia 公布财报之前引领人工智能救济反弹
summary: Tariff insecurity and AI disruption are the flavors of the week as a sharp sell-off kick-started the final week of February
summary_zh: 关税不安全和人工智能颠覆是本周的焦点，二月最后一周开始出现大幅抛售

title: AI scare: Citrini's report is just a 'thought experiment' for now
title_zh: AI 恐慌：Citrini 的报告目前只是一个“思想实验”
summary: A new AI sell-off has spooked markets (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) and the tech sector in Monday's session after a report from Citrini Research outlined a scenario of mass layoffs that could occur in 2028 due to AI.
summary_zh: 在 Citrini Research 的一份报告概述了人工智能可能在 2028 年发生大规模裁员的情景后，周一的交易中，新的人工智能抛售令市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）和科技行业感到恐慌。

title: Tesla Europe sales tumble 17% in January as China's BYD soars
title_zh: 随着中国比亚迪的飙升，特斯拉欧洲 1 月份销量暴跌 17%
summary: Tesla's Europe woes are only getting worse, just as Chinese rival BYD's fortunes soar.
summary_zh: 特斯拉在欧洲的困境只会变得更糟，而中国竞争对手比亚迪的财富却在飙升。

title: Anthropic launches new enterprise offerings, raising the heat on software companies
title_zh: Anthropic 推出新的企业产品，引发软件公司的关注
summary: Anthropic is launching a slew of new enterprise capabilities for its AI bot Claude, putting increased pressure on software companies.
summary_zh: Anthropic 正在为其人工智能机器人 Claude 推出一系列新的企业功能，这给软件公司带来了越来越大的压力。
